definitions.explanation: The department within a company or organization responsible for general administrative matters — office management, facilities, company-wide events, supplies, and other functions not handled by specialized departments.

examples.japanese: {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work in the general affairs department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{備品|びひん}→備品：16253_bihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総務部|そうむぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The general affairs department is in charge of purchasing office supplies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歓迎会|かんげいかい}→歓迎会：15791_kangeikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{総務部|そうむぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{企画|きかく}した→企画する：29396_kikakusuru⟧。
examples.english: The welcome party for new employees was organized by the general affairs department.

examples.japanese: {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧、⟦{労務|ろうむ}→労務：19480_roumu⟧、⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{幅広|はばひろ}い→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The general affairs department handles a wide range of duties including personnel, labor relations, and facilities management.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧ ('general affairs') and ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ ('department; division'). The ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ suffix is standard for major departmental divisions within companies: ⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧ ('sales department'), ⟦{人事部|じんじぶ}→人事部：20638_jinjibu⟧ ('HR department'), {経理部|けいりぶ} ('accounting department').

USAGE:
A standard department name in Japanese companies, government offices, schools, and other organizations. The scope of the department varies by organization, but typically covers general administrative functions that don't fall under a specialized department. In smaller companies it may also absorb HR and accounting duties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work in the general affairs department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: head of the general affairs department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be assigned to the general affairs department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦{所属|しょぞく}→所属：12750_shozoku⟧: affiliated with the general affairs department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: in charge on behalf of the general affairs department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to make an inquiry to the general affairs department

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧: general affairs — the field itself; can also refer to the department in abbreviation
- ⟦{庶務|しょむ}→庶務：20657_shomu⟧: general office work — similar but more clerical; in older or smaller organizations
- ⟦{人事部|じんじぶ}→人事部：20638_jinjibu⟧: HR department — handles hiring, evaluation, personnel records
- {経理部|けいりぶ}: accounting department — handles bookkeeping and finance
- {管理部|かんりぶ}: management / administration department — sometimes used for an umbrella of administrative functions

CULTURAL NOTE:
The scope of ⟦{総務|そうむ}→総務：16143_soumu⟧ in Japanese companies often includes tasks that in Western companies might be split among HR, facilities, and administration. It frequently plans company events, handles relations with shareholders and auditors, and manages internal communications.
